previous_assumption: assumed notification and dashboard attention-panel links pointing at base list routes like /requirements or /billing (instead of a specific record) was acceptable since real per-id detail pages did not exist yet for those resources
correction: Stale by the time of this check -- /requirements/[id] and /quotations/[id] detail pages already existed. Client-reported portal-wide: NotificationBell's ROUTE_BY_RESOURCE_TYPE map was also silently missing three resource types that real notify() calls actually emit -- invoice, work_order, transport -- so those notifications did nothing at all when clicked, not even navigate to a wrong page, since a missing map entry short-circuits navigation entirely. RenterDashboard/RentalCompanyDashboard's Waiting-on-you attention items had the identical generic-link bug for quotations, invoices, requirements, machines, rentals -- only the auction-related items (added later) were already correctly parametrized with query params. Auction and Billing/Invoice have no [id] detail page at all -- Auction already had a working ?auctionId= query-param convention on /auctions to reuse; Billing had no such convention at all, so one was added (?invoiceId= auto-expands and highlights the matching InvoiceRow). Transport was the deepest gap: its [id] page required a rentalId query param to load at all (listTransportForRental plus client-side filter by id, no get-by-id capability existed, an explicitly documented limitation in the page's own dead-end EmptyState) -- a notification only carries the transport record's own id, so this class of link could never work there without first adding TransportRepositoryPort.findById, TransportService.getTransportById (branches by organization type exactly like listByRental), and a new GET .../transport-records/:id route. Bonus bug caught in the same file: transport/[id]/page.tsx's own permission gate was hasPermission('transport.manage') unconditionally, which is rental_company-only per PERMISSION_ORGANIZATION_TYPES -- the page was unconditionally unreachable for every Renter regardless of role, the identical wrong-org-type-permission-checked bug class as the getRental/notifications fixes earlier this session. Worth grepping any other [id] page's own top-level hasPermission gate (not just its ancillary-data gates) for the same single-org-type mistake.
